# Dependency Refresh PR On PR62 Browser Transport Blocker

## Summary

Create a new stacked branch on top of `origin/codex/pr62-split-06-browser-transport-blocker`, update all root direct dependencies/devDependencies to their latest intended channels, research and apply required migrations, then open a draft PR with validation notes.

Use these decisions:
- “All dependencies” means root `package.json` direct dependencies/devDependencies plus `bun.lock`.
- Include Angular 22 and TypeScript 6.
- Preserve prerelease channels already chosen by the repo: Effect packages to latest `4.0.0-beta.*`, Drizzle packages to latest `1.0.0-rc.*`.
- Update Bun/Docker/CI toolchain versions only where peer/engine validation requires it.

Primary references to check during implementation:
- [Angular version compatibility](https://angular.dev/reference/versions)
- [Angular update guide](https://angular.dev/update-guide)
- [Stripe Node changelog](https://github.com/stripe/stripe-node/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Cloudflare TypeScript SDK changelog](https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-typescript/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [html-to-text changelog](https://github.com/html-to-text/node-html-to-text/blob/master/packages/html-to-text/CHANGELOG.md)

## Key Changes

- Start with branch hygiene:
  - Fetch `origin`.
  - Check out `origin/codex/pr62-split-06-browser-transport-blocker` at the current remote tip, not the stale detached local commit.
  - Create a Git Town child branch, for example `codex/pr62-dependency-refresh`, using repo conventions.

- Update dependency groups deliberately:
  - Angular family to `22.0.x`: `@angular/*`, `@angular/build`, `@angular/cli`, `angular-eslint`, `playwright-ng-schematics`, and `@fortawesome/angular-fontawesome` if its Angular 22 peer requires v5.
  - TypeScript to `6.0.x`; keep Angular compiler/build peer range satisfied.
  - Effect family from `4.0.0-beta.60` to latest `4.0.0-beta.*` across `effect`, `@effect/platform-bun`, `@effect/sql-pg`, `@effect/opentelemetry`, and `@effect/vitest`.
  - Drizzle family from `1.0.0-rc.2` to latest `1.0.0-rc.*` across `drizzle-orm`, `drizzle-kit`, and `drizzle-seed`.
  - Update remaining direct packages shown by `bun outdated`, including Stripe, Cloudflare SDK, Sentry, Tiptap, Tailwind/PostCSS, Playwright, Auth0, Google Maps loader, eslint tooling, Prettier tooling, and type packages.
  - Update `packageManager`, Dockerfile, Docker Compose, and GitHub Actions Bun references if Angular/TypeScript/tooling engines require newer Bun than `1.3.11`.

- Apply migrations only where compile/tests prove they are needed:
  - Angular/Material: run `ng update` where possible, inspect generated changes, and keep app SSR/cookie-auth behavior intact.
  - Stripe: validate `Stripe.LatestApiVersion`, webhook construction, checkout session params, and connected-account options against Stripe v22 types.
  - Cloudflare: verify `client.images.v2.directUploads.create` still compiles and returns the same required fields.
  - html-to-text/marked: verify the event metadata conversion and migration markdown conversion behavior; no old-to-new production migration logic should be added in this stack.
  - ESLint/Prettier/unicorn/Tailwind plugin: accept formatting/lint rule fixes only when caused by updated tools.

## Documentation And Decisions

- Do not create `CONTEXT.md`: dependency/toolchain updates do not introduce domain language.
- Do not create an ADR by default: updating to current dependency versions is visible in manifests and reversible enough.
- Add a short ADR only if implementation forces a surprising hard-to-reverse decision, such as deliberately pinning away from Angular 22 after attempting it.
- Add a release/change file only if repo conventions or CI require it; use the smallest compatible Knope/change-file format after inspecting existing config.

## Test Plan

Run in this order, fixing failures before moving on:

- `bun install --frozen-lockfile` after lockfile generation.
- `bun run lint`
- `bun run format:write`
- `bun run build:app`
- `bun run test:unit`
- `bun run test:unit:server`
- Targeted smoke tests for risky integrations:
  - Stripe checkout/webhook unit or Playwright specs.
  - Cloudflare image direct-upload tests if present.
  - Event details metadata conversion around `html-to-text`.
  - Migration-only markdown conversion if migration tests exist.
- `bun run docker:check` and a Docker build/compose validation if Bun image/toolchain changed.
- Run full `bun run test:e2e` only after unit/build/lint are clean, or document why it could not be completed locally.

## PR Requirements

- Open a draft PR stacked on `codex/pr62-split-06-browser-transport-blocker`.
- PR body should include:
  - dependency groups updated,
  - major migration notes,
  - runtime/toolchain changes,
  - schema/runtime impact,
  - exact local validation commands and results,
  - any skipped validation with reason.
- Do not edit `repos/` vendored sources.
- Do not add old-to-new production migration code in this relaunch stack.
</proposed_plan>
